tool_config.name: correct_rule
tool_config.description: Record the expert's correction to one rule you explained back: a limit, an exception, or a point where they stop and ask. Call it once per corrected rule, then read the corrected rule back to the expert.

rule_number.description: The number of the rule being corrected, as numbered in the process you were given.

correction.description: What should change, in the expert's own words.
